items.q: How long does it take to find candidates?
items.a: The average time is 2-4 weeks depending on the complexity of the position.

items.q: How much does the service cost?
items.a: We work with commission per successful hire. We only charge when you hire the candidate.

items.q: How does hiring talent in Colombia work?
items.a: We handle the search, pre-selection and evaluation. You just choose and hire.

items.q: Can I cancel if I'm not satisfied?
items.a: Yes, you can cancel at any time. We only charge if you hire.
